Results.ReviewText: Weber decided to change the design of the inside of grill cabinet. The hole that used to hold the propane tank nicely is now larger. Consequently, the tank now falls through to the ground unless you mount it on the hook. It is very difficult to accomplish hanging a full propane tank on the hook inside the cabinet. I am not happy with this redesign. I would not have purchased another Weber grill had I known that they increased the size of the hole in the cabinet. When contacting Weber they suggested I or the place I bought it from should modify the hole in the cabinet. For the money I paid for the grill, Weber should come up with a modification and send it to customers who don’t wish to lift and mount the propane tank.
Results.Title: Weber redesign.

Results.ReviewText:
The grill works well but the red tape involved in registering and getting any useful help is nightmarish. I bought a Spirit E-310 from my favorite hardware store and bought a Weber rotisserie afterward because they didn't have it in stock. The smallest part for the rotisserie is lost at the moment, Making it the shortest lived $100+ rotisserie in my life.

I am accustomed to paying more for quality, but that usually comes with intelligently integrated support for all problems. I am happy with the performance and features of the grill and expect it to last a very long time, but just now I am wondering if I will be frustrated for that many years in return. It should not be this hard.

EDIT - to post this review I had to read and agree to the most bizarre two and a half screens of "terms and conditions" for posting a review that I have ever seen. If I had any inkling of the hassles that came with my new Weber grill I would have crossed it off the list. No more Weber for me.
Results.Title: Red tape completely ruins the experience.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
